summary: A Depth subscription on an NFO future with OI: the dk snapshot with five levels a side, then a df delta that changes the best bid and the best ask's quantity only.

notes: AliceBlue's own order counts (bo, so), which the web publishes too since web #2473.
Depth OI from the documented oi, toi kept as a fallback, on both sides (FeedSnap::apply; aliceblue_mapping.py `QUOTE_FIELD_MAP`).
The delta carries only the changed keys, as Noren's df does; both merge it per level and field (aliceblue_adapter.py `_update_market_snapshot` since web #2473).

deviations.reason: The web sends AliceBlue's feed time ft as ltt in epoch seconds, an integer since web #2473 (aliceblue_adapter.py `_feed_time`, `_quote_fields`); the docs key ltt is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md).

The web's Depth timestamp is AliceBlue's feed time ft in epoch seconds (aliceblue_adapter.py `_on_data_received`, web #2473); the frame timestamp is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), and the desktop sends its receipt time.
